name: Takayama Kaho
source:
Kaho is the little sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c54837]Makoto[/url]'s father and so is Makoto's aunt. However, their age difference is not great (10 years maximum) and Makoto considers her as his big sister (because she speaks and acts like a boy) and she also sees him as her little brother.

She loved Makoto from the day of his birth and came to play with him well before the death of his sister-in-law. When her sister-in-law died, she played a very, very important role in Makoto's life. She comforted him, played with him and took baths with him although she was already a high school girl. It was during this period that she began to sexually harass him and dress provocatively. Her relationship with Makoto remained unchanged until [url=https://vndb.org/c51439]Ayame[/url] came into their lives. She had to stop some things even though Ayame and Kaho became good friends.

Some time after high school, Kaho married and a few years later, her brother died (Makoto's father). Years later, when Makoto left for university, Kaho asked her husband if she could go live with Ayame to help run the shop and he agreed (Kaho would have gone there even without his permission because her husband work away and is almost never at home). She mainly manages the adult department.

Kaho (sexually) has always wanted Makoto and when Ayame isn't here, she secretly enters Makoto's room to do some things. When Makoto returns, she resumes sexual harassment (which is sometimes open proposals) and even tells him that she wants to be the one who will take his virginity. However, Ayame is still putting herself between them and - in these moments - Kaho considered her as an obstacle that prevents her from getting closer to her Makoto.

Kaho takes care of her body and her appearance. She knows she is very attractive : She has a generous bosom and harmonious curves, she is thin and she shaves completely in order to be able to seduce Makoto.

[spoiler]In reality, Kaho has big marital problems and her marriage isn't going well at all. Her husband is never there and the few times they see each other, they argue. She hasn't had sex with her husband for years. Although her marriage went very badly, she never cheated on her husband and she tries to maintain her marriage.

She acts in front of Makoto like if she was "slutty" but in reality she is like that only with him (because she has feelings for him).[/spoiler]
